title: Re-Sent Returned Payouts — Amount Terms under Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
Payout terms, section on re-sent payouts — Cartwise Shopper Payouts.

**1. Which returned transfer is answered.** The re-send answers the latest returned-transfer entry on the account, that is, the most recently booked entry recording that a deposit or cashout came back.

**2. The amount still to re-send.** The amount still to re-send is that entry's amount less every re-send deposit already pointing to it, rounded to the cent. A re-send deposit "points to" the returned-transfer entry it answers; weekly sweep deposits that point to no returned-transfer entry do not reduce the amount still to re-send.

**3. The re-send.** The re-send is that amount still to re-send, sent in full to the destination now on file, with nothing set off or kept back, rounded to the cent. The re-send is never a negative figure, and whatever is not re-sent stays on the unpaid earnings balance.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Input read from the account | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The latest returned-transfer entry and its amount | This is the entry the re-send answers | Its amount is the starting figure |
| Re-send deposits already pointing to that entry | Their amounts are added together | The total is taken off the starting figure |
| What remains | Rounded to the cent | This is the re-send amount, sent in full to the destination on file |

### Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical account has two returned-transfer entries: 40.00 booked in March and 85.30 booked in May. The May entry is the latest, so the re-send answers it. One re-send deposit of 20.00 already points to the May entry; no re-send deposit points to the March entry, but that entry is not the one answered.

- Amount still to re-send: 85.30 less 20.00, which is 65.30.
- The re-send is 65.30, sent in full to the destination now on file.

Had no re-send deposit pointed to the May entry, the re-send would be the full 85.30. Had re-send deposits totalling 85.30 already pointed to it, the amount still to re-send would be 0.00.
